'''Muugyn's Plan''' was the battle plan sketched out by [[Worr Muugyn]] on a piece of leather cut from his tabard during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. Muugyn led a small group of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] in holding a fortified position called "[[Blood Ridge]]" on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vur IV]] against a larger [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] force, and the piece of leather became a symbol of courage and determination to the Mandalorian clans in the years after the battle..<ref name="Muugyn">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Mandalorian Relics: Muugyn's Plan}}</ref>
